title: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Act 2007

sections.shortTitle: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Act 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2007
ACT V OF 2007
NATIONAL DATABASE AND
REGISTRATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2007
An Act to amend the National Database and Registration Authority
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 5th July,
2007]
No.F.9(4)/2007-Legis., dated 5-7-2007.---The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 30th June, 2007 and is hereby published
for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the National
Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
National Database and Registration Authority (Amendment) Act, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3 Ordinance VIII of 2000

ACT V OF 2007
ACT V OF 2007
NATIONAL DATABASE AND
REGISTRATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2007
An Act to amend the National Database and Registration Authority
Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 5th July,
2007]
No.F.9(4)/2007-Legis., dated 5-7-2007.---The
following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 30th June, 2007 and is hereby published
for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the National
Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance VIII of
2000.---(1) In the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance,
2000(VIII of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section
3,---
(a) in subsection (3),--
(i)
after the word "and" the words "not
less than" shall be inserted; and
(ii) in
the proviso, for full stop, at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following further proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided further that the Federal Government
may, from time to time, by Notification in the official Gazette, increase or
decrease the number of members and prescribe mode of their appointment as it may
deem fit."; and
(b) in subsection (5), for the word "such
shorter term not exceeding one year", the words "a similar term or
terms" shall be substituted; and
(c) in subsection (8), for
the colon a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso shall be omitted.
